sourceChecks.text: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB 1CH 16:38はホサを門衛の一人として記す。メラリ族との関係は後の26:10に限って扱う。

sourceChecks.text: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB 26:10はホサの子らの中でシムリが長に任じられたことを述べる。ヒルキヤ以降の名は次節26:11で扱う。

sourceChecks.text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB 26:11はヒルキヤ、テバリヤ、ゼカリヤの順序とホサの息子・兄弟の総数を記す。

sourceChecks.text: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と前後の系譜/名簿文脈を確認。

profileDecisionJa: 主の箱の門衛として名が記されています。
